tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the model catalog. Returns ids, modality, tasks, pricing and links. Use before calling run_model or submit_job to pick a model id.

tools.name: get_model_schema
tools.description: Input parameters (name, type, allowed values, defaults) and output shape for every task a model supports.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Live price per image or per video clip for one model or all models.

tools.name: run_model
tools.description: Run a model synchronously with the caller's API key. Images return URLs; videos are queued and this waits up to 60 s before returning the queue status instead.

tools.name: submit_job
tools.description: Queue a request and return its request_id immediately. Follow with check_job / get_job_result.

tools.name: check_job
tools.description: Status of a queued request (IN_QUEUE / IN_PROGRESS / COMPLETED / FAILED / CANCELLED) with position, logs and metrics.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: Result of a completed request; waits up to `timeout` seconds (max 60) when still running.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a request while it is still queued.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_models" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the model catalog. Returns ids, modality, tasks, pricing and links. Use before calling run_model or submit_job to pick a model id.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
